subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Sequence the days of the week and months of the year; place birthdays on the calendar

show.line: Twelve months make a year! January, February, March, April. Which month is your birthday?

rounds.prompt: Say the months with me. January, February, and then?
Which month comes next? October, November, and then?
rounds.praise: December! The last month of the year.

rounds.prompt: Which month comes first in the year?
Count the months on the calendar. How many months in a year?

rounds.story: Lindi's birthday is in the month after March. Which month is it?

rounds.prompt: What comes next? Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and then?

hints: Sing the months in order. January, February, March.
December is the last month. Then January starts again.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the months.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! After February comes March, then April.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say them together. January, February, March, April!

parent_line: Can name the months of the year in order and find a birthday month.
